Remote changes reach a connected child device in a few seconds. If a device is offline, it cannot receive an early End command until it reconnects, but it cannot continue beyond its last confirmed deadline.

Using Guided Access

WatchNest stops playback when its timer ends. Guided Access can keep your child inside WatchNest, but Apple does not let this website read or control the Guided Access timer. Use Guided Access for navigation protection and the WatchNest timer for stopping video and sound.
